#Module crypto

Web Crypto: random values, UUIDs and digests (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 through BCrypt; large inputs are hashed on a worker thread).

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/crypto.widl.

#Functions

#Crypto_getRandomValues

void Crypto_getRandomValues(out bytes destination) raises

crypto.getRandomValues(destination). Quota past crypto.max_random_bytes.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Crypto_getRandomValues :: proc(c: ^Call, destination: []u8) -> Api_Error

#Crypto_randomUUID

string Crypto_randomUUID() raises

crypto.randomUUID()

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Has effects: call it once per result (no length query).

Host: Crypto_randomUUID :: proc(c: ^Call) -> (string, Api_Error)

#SubtleCrypto_digest

Promise<Buffer> SubtleCrypto_digest(string algorithm, bytes data)

crypto.subtle.digest(algorithm, data): settles with a buffer; rejected with Not_Supported for an unknown algorithm.

Host: SubtleCrypto_digest :: proc(c: ^Call, algorithm: string, data: []u8) -> u64

#SubtleCrypto_digestBuffer

Promise<Buffer> SubtleCrypto_digestBuffer(string algorithm, Buffer data)

The same over a buffer.

Host: SubtleCrypto_digestBuffer :: proc(c: ^Call, algorithm: string, data: Api_Buffer) -> u64
